using namespace std;
 
using ll = long long;
using tf = ll;
using tc = ll;
const tf INF = 1e9;

struct MCF {
    int n;
    vector<tc> prio, pot;
    vector<tf> curflow;
    vector<int> prevedge, prevnode;
    priority_queue<pair<tc, int>, vector<pair<tc, int>>, greater<pair<tc, int>>> q;
    
    struct edge {
        int to, rev;
        tf f, cap;
        tc cost;
    };
    
    vector<vector<edge>> g;
    
    MCF(int n) : n(n), prio(n), curflow(n), prevedge(n), prevnode(n), pot(n), g(n) {}
    
    void add_edge(int s, int t, tf cap, tc cost) {
        g[s].push_back({t, (int)g[t].size(), 0, cap, cost});
        g[t].push_back({s, (int)g[s].size() - 1, 0, 0, -cost});
    }
    
    pair<tf, tc> get_flow(int s, int t) {
        tf flow = 0;
        tc flowcost = 0;
        
        while (true) {
            q.push({0, s});
            fill(prio.begin(), prio.end(), INF);
            prio[s] = 0;
            curflow[s] = INF;
            
            while (!q.empty()) {
                auto cur = q.top();
                tc d = cur.first;
                int u = cur.second;
                q.pop();
                
                if (d != prio[u]) continue;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[u].size(); ++i) {
                    edge &e = g[u][i];
                    int v = e.to;
                    
                    if (e.cap <= e.f) continue;
                    
                    tc nprio = prio[u] + e.cost + pot[u] - pot[v];
                    if (prio[v] > nprio) {
                        prio[v] = nprio;
                        q.push({nprio, v});
                        prevnode[v] = u;
                        prevedge[v] = i;
                        curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (prio[t] == INF) break;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                pot[i] += prio[i];
            
            tf df = min(curflow[t], INF - flow);
            flow += df;
            
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                edge &e = g[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                e.f += df;
                g[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                flowcost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }
        
        return {flow, flowcost};
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    
    const int T = 500;
    int N = n * T;
    MCF mcf(N + 2);
    
    // Wait edges: stay in same city for next time unit
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; ++j)
            mcf.add_edge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, INF, c);
    
    // Source connections: arrival at city 0 at time i
    for (int i = 0; i < T; ++i)
        mcf.add_edge(i, N + 1, INF, 0);
    
    // People starting at their cities at time 0
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        mcf.add_edge(N, x * T, 1, 0);
    }
    
    // Travel edges between cities
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        --x; --y;
        
        for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; ++j) {
            int cur = 1;
            for (int _ = 0; _ < k; ++_) {
                mcf.add_edge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                mcf.add_edge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                cur += 2;
            }
        }
    }
